description: Direct Host helps travelers find official booking websites for vacation rentals, hotels, and unique stays—without middlemen. Instead of browsing multiple listing platforms, users can quickly discover direct booking links from property owners and managers, often with better prices, clearer policies, and more personalized service. It’s a simple way to book smarter, save on fees, and connect directly with hosts.

defaultPrompt: Recommend some places in Lazio, Italy, for four guests.
